# ============================================================
# SOCK SHOP - KUBERNETES DEPLOYMENT
# ============================================================
# Namespace: sock-shop
#
# Includes:
# - Namespace
# - Secrets
# - Deployments for stateless services
# - StatefulSets with persistent storage for databases
# - ClusterIP Services for internal communication
# - LoadBalancer Service for external access
# - Resource requests and limits
# - Security contexts and Linux capabilities
# - Health checks
# - PodDisruptionBudgets
# - Optional suspended load-testing CronJob
#
# IMPORTANT:
# - Replace the database password before deployment.
# - Use an external secret manager for real production secrets.
# - The supplied application and database image versions are
#   legacy/deprecated and require security review or upgrades.
# - Persistent storage requires a default StorageClass.
# - Deploy behind a TLS-enabled ingress or load balancer.
# - Do not expose database ports publicly.
# ============================================================

apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: sock-shop
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: sock-shop
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: sock-shop
    kubernetes.io/metadata.name: sock-shop

---
# ============================================================
# DATABASE CREDENTIALS
# ============================================================

apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: catalogue-db-secret
  namespace: sock-shop
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: sock-shop
type: Opaque
stringData:
  MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: "REPLACE_WITH_STRONG_RANDOM_PASSWORD"

---
# ============================================================
# FRONT-END
# ============================================================

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: front-end
  namespace: sock-shop
  labels:
    app: front-end
    tier: frontend
spec:
  replicas: 2
  revisionHistoryLimit: 3
  strategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
    rollingUpdate:
      maxSurge: 1
      maxUnavailable: 0
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: front-end
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: front-end
        tier: frontend
    spec:
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 30
      securityContext:
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: front-end
          image: weaveworksdemos/front-end:0.3.12
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          ports:
            - name: http
              containerPort: 8079
              protocol: TCP
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 128Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 500m
              memory: 512Mi
          securityContext:
            runAsNonRoot: true
            runAsUser: 10001
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            capabilities:
              drop:
                - ALL
          startupProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /
              port: http
            failureThreshold: 30
            periodSeconds: 10
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /
              port: http
            periodSeconds: 10
            timeoutSeconds: 5
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /
              port: http
            periodSeconds: 20
            timeoutSeconds: 5
            failureThreshold: 3

---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: front-end
  namespace: sock-shop
  labels:
    app: front-end
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  selector:
    app: front-end
  ports:
    - name: http
      port: 80
      targetPort: http
      protocol: TCP

---
# ============================================================
# EDGE ROUTER
# ============================================================

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: edge-router
  namespace: sock-shop
  labels:
    app: edge-router
    tier: gateway
spec:
  replicas: 2
  revisionHistoryLimit: 3
  strategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
    rollingUpdate:
      maxSurge: 1
      maxUnavailable: 0
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: edge-router
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: edge-router
        tier: gateway
    spec:
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 30
      securityContext:
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: edge-router
          image: weaveworksdemos/edge-router:0.1.1
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          ports:
            - name: http
              containerPort: 80
              protocol: TCP
            - name: admin
              containerPort: 8080
              protocol: TCP
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 128Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 500m
              memory: 512Mi
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            capabilities:
              drop:
                - ALL
              add:
                - NET_BIND_SERVICE
                - CHOWN
                - SETGID
                - SETUID
                - DAC_OVERRIDE
          volumeMounts:
            - name: run
              mountPath: /var/run
          startupProbe:
            tcpSocket:
              port: http
            failureThreshold: 30
            periodSeconds: 10
          readinessProbe:
            tcpSocket:
              port: http
            periodSeconds: 10
          livenessProbe:
            tcpSocket:
              port: http
            periodSeconds: 20
      volumes:
        - name: run
          emptyDir:
            medium: Memory
            sizeLimit: 64Mi

---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: edge-router
  namespace: sock-shop
  labels:
    app: edge-router
spec:
  type: LoadBalancer
  externalTrafficPolicy: Cluster
  selector:
    app: edge-router
  ports:
    - name: http
      port: 80
      targetPort: http
      protocol: TCP

---
# Internal access to the edge-router administrative port.
# This port is not exposed through the external LoadBalancer.

apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: edge-router-admin
  namespace: sock-shop
  labels:
    app: edge-router
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  selector:
    app: edge-router
  ports:
    - name: admin
      port: 8080
      targetPort: admin
      protocol: TCP

---

# CATALOGUE SERVICE
# ============================================================

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: catalogue
  namespace: sock-shop
  labels:
    app: catalogue
    tier: backend
spec:
  replicas: 2
  revisionHistoryLimit: 3
  strategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
    rollingUpdate:
      maxSurge: 1
      maxUnavailable: 0
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: catalogue
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: catalogue
        tier: backend
    spec:
      securityContext:
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: catalogue
          image: weaveworksdemos/catalogue:0.3.5
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          command:
            - /app
          args:
            - -port=80
          ports:
            - name: http
              containerPort: 80
              protocol: TCP
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 100Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 500m
              memory: 256Mi
          securityContext:
            runAsNonRoot: true
            runAsUser: 10001
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            capabilities:
              drop:
                - ALL
              add:
                - NET_BIND_SERVICE
          startupProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /health
              port: http
            failureThreshold: 30
            periodSeconds: 10
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /health
              port: http
            periodSeconds: 10
            timeoutSeconds: 5
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /health
              port: http
            periodSeconds: 20
            timeoutSeconds: 5

---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: catalogue
  namespace: sock-shop
  labels:
    app: catalogue
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  selector:
    app: catalogue
  ports:
    - name: http
      port: 80
      targetPort: http

---
# ============================================================
# CATALOGUE DATABASE - MYSQL

apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:

  namespace: sock-shop
  labels:
    app: catalogue-db
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  clusterIP: None
  selector:
    app: catalogue-db
  ports:
    - name: mysql
      port: 3306
      targetPort: mysql

---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: StatefulSet
metadata:
  name: catalogue-db
  namespace: sock-shop
  labels:
    app: catalogue-db
    tier: database
spec:
  serviceName: catalogue-db
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: catalogue-db
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: catalogue-db
        tier: database
    spec:
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 60
      securityContext:
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: catalogue-db
          image: weaveworksdemos/catalogue-db:0.3.0
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          ports:
            - name: mysql
              containerPort: 3306
          env:
            - name: MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: catalogue-db-secret
                  key: MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD
            - name: MYSQL_DATABASE
              value: socksdb
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 256Mi
            limits:
              cpu: "1"
              memory: 1Gi
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop:
                - ALL
              add:
                - CHOWN
                - SETGID
                - SETUID
                - DAC_OVERRIDE
          volumeMounts:
            - name: mysql-data
              mountPath: /var/lib/mysql
          startupProbe:
            tcpSocket:
              port: mysql
            failureThreshold: 60
            periodSeconds: 5
          readinessProbe:
            tcpSocket:
              port: mysql
            periodSeconds: 10
          livenessProbe:
            tcpSocket:
              port: mysql
            periodSeconds: 30
  volumeClaimTemplates:
    - metadata:
        name: mysql-data
      spec:
        accessModes:
          - ReadWriteOnce
        resources:
          requests:
            storage: 10Gi

            limits:
              cpu: 500m
              memory: 512Mi
          securityContext:
            runAsNonRoot: true
            runAsUser: 10001
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            capabilities:
              drop:

            failureThreshold: 60
            periodSeconds: 5
          readinessProbe:
            tcpSocket:
              port: mongo
            periodSeconds: 10
          livenessProbe:
            tcpSocket:
              port: mongo
            periodSeconds: 30

        - name: tmp
          emptyDir:
            medium: Memory
            sizeLimit: 128Mi

          requests:

# ============================================================
# DEFAULT NETWORK POLICY
# ============================================================
# Allow DNS and application traffic while preventing arbitrary
# external access to internal database Services.
#
# This policy restricts ingress to database and broker Pods.
# It does not impose namespace-wide default-deny isolation.
# Additional namespace-wide policies may be required for
# stricter production network segmentation.

apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: database-ingress
  namespace: sock-shop
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchExpressions:
      - key: tier
        operator: In
        values:
          - database
          - messaging
  policyTypes:
    - Ingress
  ingress:
    - from:
        - podSelector:
            matchLabels:
              tier: backend
        - podSelector:
            matchLabels:
              tier: worker
      ports:
        - protocol: TCP
          port: 3306
        - protocol: TCP
          port: 27017
        - protocol: TCP
          port: 5672

---
# ============================================================
# OPTIONAL USER SIMULATOR
# ============================================================
# Load testing is disabled by default.
#
# The Compose service:
#   weaveworksdemos/load-test:0.1.1
#   -d 60 -r 200 -c 2 -h edge-router
#
# is represented as a suspended CronJob.
#
# To run manually:
# kubectl create job --from=cronjob/user-sim \
#   user-sim-manual -n sock-shop
#
# WARNING:
# This workload generates synthetic traffic and must not
# be enabled against a production deployment without approval.

apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: CronJob
metadata:
  name: user-sim
  namespace: sock-shop
  labels:
    app: user-sim
    tier: testing
spec:
  schedule: "0 2 * * *"
  suspend: true
  concurrencyPolicy: Forbid
  successfulJobsHistoryLimit: 1
  failedJobsHistoryLimit: 2
  jobTemplate:
    spec:
      backoffLimit: 1
      activeDeadlineSeconds: 180
      ttlSecondsAfterFinished: 3600
      template:
        metadata:
          labels:
            app: user-sim
            tier: testing
        spec:
          restartPolicy: Never
          securityContext:
            seccompProfile:
              type: RuntimeDefault
          containers:
            - name: user-sim
              image: weaveworksdemos/load-test:0.1.1
              imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
              args:
                - "-d"
                - "60"
                - "-r"
                - "200"
                - "-c"
                - "2"
                - "-h"
                - "edge-router"
              resources:
                requests:
                  cpu: 100m
                  memory: 128Mi
                limits:
                  cpu: 500m
                  memory: 512Mi
              securityContext:
                allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
                readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
                capabilities:
                  drop:
                    - ALL
